prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic candid balcony portrait of an approved adult man overlooking a sunny mountain landscape.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man with naturally messy voluminous dark hair, relaxed expression, and arms crossed while leaning on a bright yellow balcony railing. He wears a fuzzy red knitted polo sweater with white collar and loose light-beige jeans.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical slightly low-angle portrait with yellow railings and pillars, rolling green hills, mountains, houses, trees, blue sky, and wispy clouds.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural sunlight with defined shadows, realistic knit and landscape texture, calm stylish smartphone-candid mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 9:16 vertical image, realistic proportions, sharp subject, natural color, clear depth and fabric detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 9:16 candid balcony portrait of an approved adult man with messy voluminous dark hair and a relaxed expression leaning on a bright yellow railing with arms crossed. Dress him in a fuzzy red knitted polo sweater with a white collar and loose light-beige jeans. Show rolling green hills, mountains, scattered houses, trees, blue sky, and wispy clouds. Use bright sunlight, defined shadows, realistic knit and landscape textures, and relaxed sophisticated mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, exact face copy, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted landscape
